URL: https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-september-27-2026
(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; ISW/CTP's own reporting language. Joint ISW-CTP report; understandingwar.org copy also 403'd and not indexed. Snippets below are search-engine summaries of the report's Key Takeaways.)

- Ukrainian forces appear to be shifting their counteroffensive tactics toward systematically targeting Russian efforts to reinforce initial Russian infiltrations rather than focusing on clearing the infiltrators immediately in various sectors of the frontline.
- Russian milbloggers continue emphasizing how the pervasive culture of lying within the Russian military is facilitating Ukrainian successes north and northeast of Lyman.
- A prominent Kremlin-affiliated milblogger is embracing Russian President Vladimir Putin's new theory of victory that relies on expansive long-range combined ballistic missile and jet-powered drone strikes against Ukraine to force Ukraine to capitulate over Winter 2026-2027.
- The milblogger acknowledged that the frontline is "static" — a tacit acknowledgement of Russia's near-zero net battlefield advances in recent months.
- Russian forces launched 162 Geran-type drones (including 76 jet-powered ones) during September 25, followed by 173 Shahed-type strike drones (of which over 50 were jet-powered) launched overnight. Ukrainian forces downed 134 of the overnight drones.
